items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Will Hudson (PHONETIC) had brought us one chorus arranged on "Moonglow" to the Cotton Club

ctx.x: Right. And then before we went to Europe we made a recording session. And you know in those days you always recorded in sets of fours. So we went down that day and we only had three sides to do and we didn't have a fourth side. And Cab, most all the things -- in fact, all the things we recorded then were vocals, mostly with the band. Solos fit in here and there. But he didn't have a fourth side so in the meantime Will Hudson (PHONETIC) had brought us one chorus arranged on "Moonglow" to the Cotton Club and we had…

We did that one take and walked out of the studio and went to Europe. After we came back from Europe we were down in Texas. And we heard this record playing, you know, they always played records before the dance over the loud speaker. And we heard this saxophone playing and I said, gee.
